memory_update.text: WSO is the clean reference asset for HVAC/R replacement-cycle distribution, contractor digital tools, SKU breadth, and regional acquisition density; market cap is above the preferred underfollowed range but exposure is unusually pure.

SITE should remain in the underfollowed lane for professional landscape maintenance/repair/upgrade distribution; later layers must separate maintenance and repair/upgrade from weather and new-construction cyclicality.
NX is a small-cap component supplier with potentially hidden repair/remodel exposure through fenestration, screens, thresholds, sealants, extrusions, and cabinet/window/door OEM channels.

GFF offers a niche garage-door repair/replacement angle through Clopay and related brands; validate segment purity, dealer/installer channel strength, and steel/input pass-through before promotion to later layers.

Specialty distributors such as roofing, drywall, and pro-focused building materials may have been absorbed by larger acquirers, reducing the current US-listed pure-play universe; verify current listing status before adding BECN, GMS, or SRS-like assets.

node: Housing repair, remodel and maintenance input suppliers
summary: Layer 1B expands the housing repair/remodel input node away from homebuilders and big-box retailers. The most relevant chokepoint candidates appear to sit in specialty distribution, contractor-facing SKU breadth, component manufacturing, and replacement-cycle categories such as HVAC/R, landscape supply, fenestration components, and garage doors. This is research universe construction only, not a trading recommendation.
